source.name: measured vapour pressures and the critical point
source.fit: 7 measured values (0 from the ThermoML Archive, 7 from open-access articles), 313.15-373.15 K, max deviation 6.8 %. No measured critical constants: the record covers the measured temperatures only. All the measured sets fitted together, each article with the same weight (no set preferred for a smaller stated uncertainty), pooled because they agree: each set lies within its mean stated uncertainty of the curve on average; mean deviation of the fit from each set: Türck 2026 +0.00 %. The values are READ OFF A GRAPH: the article prints them only in its Figure 7 (left panel), read by the marker centres with the gridlines as the scale (one pixel = 0.043 kPa). Measured with a Herzog HVP 972 vapour-pressure tester, n = 3, solketal of at least 98 %. Stated uncertainty of each value: 16 % (the one error bar visible, at 80 degC) with the reading resolution, 16-19 %, so the record is held to 19 %, above the 1 % target, used because no open values meet the target. The readings at 20 and 30 degC (0.174 and 0.196 kPa) are left out: there one pixel is a quarter of the value, and they are almost equal where every 10 K above 40 degC raises the pressure by a factor of 1.6 to 1.8 (the lower end of the tester's range). The maintainer agreed to use the figure (2026-10-22).
